description: Audio8 TTS Preview 0.6B DualAR text-to-speech model with expressive multilingual speech across yue, zh, nl, en, fr, de, it, ja, ko, pl, and es, automatic language handling, and rapid voice cloning from short reference samples.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Reference transcript used with speaker reference audio.

request.name: multi_reference_cond
request.description: Ordered Audio8 TTS reference conditioning pairs as a JSON array: [{"audio":"ref.wav","text":"transcript"}, ...].

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum semantic tokens to generate; default 1024.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampling seed for reproducible output; omitted uses a random seed.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release cached AR runtime graphs after each request; default false.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: AR matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: codec_weight_type
session.description: Codec conv/matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: ar_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AR runtime graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: ar_weight_context_mb
session.description: AR weight context size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: codec_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec encode/decode graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: codec_weight_context_mb
session.description: Codec weight context size in MiB; default 512.

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)

description.en: Audio8 TTS Preview 0.6B DualAR text-to-speech model with expressive multilingual speech across yue, zh, nl, en, fr, de, it, ja, ko, pl, and es, automatic language handling, and rapid voice cloning from short reference samples.
description.zh: Audio8 TTS Preview 0.6B DualAR 文本转语音模型，支持粤语、中文、荷兰语、英语、法语、德语、意大利语、日语、韩语、波兰语、西班牙语的富有表现力多语言语音，自动处理语言，并可从短参考样本快速克隆音色。

reference_text.en: Reference transcript used with speaker reference audio.
reference_text.zh: 配合说话人参考音频使用的参考文本。

multi_reference_cond.en: Ordered Audio8 TTS reference conditioning pairs as a JSON array: [{"audio":"ref.wav","text":"transcript"}, ...].
multi_reference_cond.zh: 有序的 Audio8 TTS 参考条件对，JSON 数组：[{"audio":"ref.wav","text":"transcript"}, ...]。

max_tokens.en: Maximum semantic tokens to generate; default 1024.
max_tokens.zh: 最多生成的语义 token 数；默认 1024。

temperature.zh: 语义 token 采样温度，取值 (0, 2)；默认 0.7。

seed.en: Sampling seed for reproducible output; omitted uses a random seed.
seed.zh: 用于可复现输出的采样随机种子；省略时随机。
